briefing.summary: Cruising FL220 with Brisbane Centre. Wanting to request direct to waypoint COFF for a shorter routing.

challenge.expectedText: Brisbane Centre, Mike X-ray Golf, request direct COFF.

elements.label: Request
elements.hint: Standard form is 'request direct [waypoint]' — keep it tight.

challenge.explanation: AIP ENR 1.7: routing requests are short — station, callsign, request type with the named waypoint. Centre will reply with 'cleared direct' or 'unable'.
